wnba.Headline: Nneka Ogwumike has a double-double to lead the Sparks past the Sky, 102-87
wnba.Description: — Nneka Ogwumike had 25 points, 12 rebounds and five assists, Erica Wheeler added 15 points and eight assists, and the Los Angeles Sparks beat the Chicago Sky 102-87 on Friday night.

wnba.Headline: Valkyries beat the Sun 79-64 for a franchise-record 7th straight win
wnba.Description: — Veronica Burton scored 17 points, Janelle Salaun had 16 points and four 3-pointers off the bench, and the Golden State Valkyries beat the Connecticut Sun 79-64 on Friday night for a franchise-record seventh straight victory.

wnba.Headline: WNBA regular-season record crowd of 20,996 watch Wings beat Tempo
wnba.Description: Paige Bueckers scored 34 points and Dallas beat expansion Toronto 108-95 on Friday night in front of a WNBA regular-season record crowd of 20,996 at Bell Centre.

wnba.Headline: Hammon locks up spot as WNBA All-Star coach with Aces' win
wnba.Description: The Aces' Becky Hammon will join Minnesota's Cheryl Reeve as the two WNBA All-Star coaches in Chicago on July 25.

wnba.Headline: With Caitlin Clark out, Kelsey Mitchell powers Fever past Mercury
wnba.Description: Kelsey Mitchell's layup with 10.1 seconds lifted the Fever over the Mercury 92-89 Thursday night. Mitchell put Indiana up 90-89 with her layup and Sophie Cunningham added two free throws to secure the win with Caitlin Clark on the bench in street clothes.

wnba.Headline: Aces beat the Fire 88-80 behind double-doubles by A’ja Wilson and Jackie Young
wnba.Description: — A’ja Wilson had 32 points and 10 rebounds, Jackie Young added 19 points and 11 assists, and the Las Vegas Aces beat the Portland Fire 88-80 on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: Angel Reese secures 64th career double-double and the Dream beat the Storm 89-78 to end 5-game skid
wnba.Description: — Allisha Gray scored 22 points, Angel Reese had 18 points and 11 rebounds for her league-best 15th double-double of the season, and the Atlanta Dream beat the Seattle Storm 89-78 on Thursday night to end a five-game losing streak.
